duets.lead: Season {season} is about to begin, and {managerA} and {managerB} are staring at the same blank page.
duets.co: A blank page is the most dangerous thing in a rivalry, because anything can be written on it.

duets.lead: {leader} heads into the campaign holding the lead, and {trailer} has a point to prove.
duets.co: Points to prove make the best motivation, but a lead is only as safe as the following campaign.

duets.lead: Nothing is decided yet, and the next phase of this Showdown is still face down on the table.
duets.co: Face-down cards are the most exciting thing in any game, right up until somebody turns one over.

duets.lead: {clubA} and {clubB} are raring to go, and both bosses look like they have been awake all night planning.
duets.co: Planning all night is the easy part, and the true test is whether the plan survives its first meeting with reality.

duets.lead: {managerA} is confident, {managerB} is restless, and the new round is almost here.
duets.co: Restless is good; confident people tend to get caught out when the restless ones stop sitting still.

duets.lead: {seasons} seasons in, and the rivalry is as hot as ever going into season {season}.
duets.co: Heat like that does not cool with time; it simply moves on to the following challenge.

duets.lead: Bold promises are flying around before the campaign begins, and {managerA} has made a few big ones.
duets.co: Promises are cheap before anything has been played, and expensive once the table starts telling the truth.

duets.lead: Champions League talk is loud, and {managerA} says the cabinet has room for more.
duets.co: Cabinets only fill when the trophies are actually won, and that is the bit nobody can promise.

duets.lead: {trailer} needs a strong opening to season {season}, and the old hands of this feud can see it.
duets.co: A strong opening will not be enough on its own, but a weak one would be a real problem.

duets.lead: {leader} sits at the top of the table, and the term ahead is the first real test of that seat.
duets.co: Top of the table is comfortable until the upcoming campaign reminds everyone how quickly that changes.

duets.lead: What is {clubA} going to do in season {season}? Nobody knows yet, and that is the fun part.
duets.co: Not knowing is the fun part, and {clubB} is probably wondering the very same thing right now.

duets.lead: Both bosses spent the break on their plans, and now the moment of truth is close.
duets.co: Plans look wonderful on paper, but the moment of truth is when they meet the Showdown.

duets.lead: {managerA} and {managerB} have their sleeves already rolled before the opener.
duets.co: Ready sleeves are a good sign, but the trick is keeping them ready when it starts to hurt.

duets.lead: Belief is at its highest, and both clubs are convinced they are the strongest outfit around.
duets.co: Everybody believes at the start, which is precisely what makes it so beautiful.

duets.lead: {leader} enters season {season} with momentum and a warning shot for everyone else.
duets.co: Momentum is a fine thing to start with, but warning shots only work if you can actually hit.

duets.lead: The term is here, and {trailer} has spent every spare minute on a comeback.
duets.co: A comeback needs a plan clever enough to surprise the leader, and that is not easy to find.

duets.lead: {managerA} has barely said a word about what lies ahead, which is ominous for everyone else.
duets.co: Silence from that corner is always worth worrying about, and {managerB} is already worried.

duets.lead: The next chapter of this rivalry is about to open, and nobody has read a line of it.
duets.co: A fresh chapter is a gift, and both bosses are eager to be the ones who write it.

duets.lead: {leader} has the lead going in, but leads have a habit of vanishing when least expected.
duets.co: Vanishing leads are a nightmare for the one holding them and a dream for everyone chasing them.

duets.lead: {trailer} has a long memory of near misses, and the chance to make amends has arrived.
duets.co: Settling a debt like that is never simple, and {trailer} knows it must be earned.

duets.lead: The tension is already intense as {clubA} prepares to meet {clubB} again.
duets.co: Intensity this early is normal, but this build-up has an extra bite.

duets.lead: With {seasons} seasons on the books, this next step feels like the real test.
duets.co: Tests of character come later, but this year will show whether this feud has more left in it.

duets.lead: Every manager says they are ready, but {managerA} and {managerB} look readier than most.
duets.co: Readier is a bold claim, and both are about to find out whether the preparation was real.

duets.lead: The mood is almost giddy around {clubA} and {clubB} as the next campaign opens.
duets.co: Giddy at the outset is how every good rivalry starts, and it never lasts long enough.

duets.lead: The advantage sits with {leader}, the hunger with {trailer}, and the upcoming term will settle the argument.
duets.co: Hunger is a powerful thing, and a lead is only a lead until someone starts to close in.

duets.lead: This is the moment where confidence meets the reality of a Showdown.
duets.co: Reality humbles even the most confident managers, and both of them know it.

duets.lead: Expectations are sky high heading into what lies ahead, and both have been hyping their chances.
duets.co: Hyping chances is a sport in itself, and few do it better than these two.

duets.lead: {trailer} has been rebuilding in private, and the outside world knows nothing of it.
duets.co: Private rebuilding is the most dangerous kind, because it gives nothing away until it is too late.

duets.lead: The friction between {managerA} and {managerB} is already buzzing as the term approaches.
duets.co: Buzzing is the right word, because no one has yet tried to quieten the noise.

duets.lead: Each year brings hopes, and {managerA} is clearly carrying a few of them.
duets.co: Hopes are heavy to carry, and {managerA} looks like someone who has packed a very full bag.

duets.lead: The year ahead is coming, and {leader} plans to keep the lead by honest means.
duets.co: Honest is the only kind of advantage worth defending, and {trailer} will be watching closely.

duets.lead: The best runs often begin with a dash of uncertainty, and the story still has plenty.
duets.co: Uncertainty sells well, and both bosses look ready to sell it to each other.

duets.lead: {managerA} says this run will be different, and {managerB} has heard that before.
duets.co: Hearing it before is what makes {managerB} so sceptical, and it is hard to blame them.

duets.lead: Both clubs head into the year with fresh ambitions and a sharp memory.
duets.co: A sharp memory is useful, but fresh ambitions are what sell the story.

duets.lead: The leader is untroubled, the trailer is eager, and the new term is upon us.
duets.co: Untroubled is pleasant, but eager is more dangerous, because chasers have nothing to lose.

duets.lead: Of everyone, {trailer} needs a new beginning most, and the moment has arrived at last.
duets.co: A perfect moment only exists if you prepare for it, and {trailer} has spent ages doing exactly that.

duets.lead: No one has written a word of the story yet, and both bosses are itching to start.
duets.co: Itching is good, as long as it does not turn into rushing, because rushing is how mistakes creep in.

duets.lead: The pair are at ease with one another, and the rest of the story is set to test that calm.
duets.co: Calm between rivals is rare, and it usually breaks the moment the points begin to matter.

duets.lead: Think of the journey ahead as a long road, with {clubA} and {clubB} setting off side by side.
duets.co: Side by side is a fine image, though the road narrows the closer they get to the finish.

duets.lead: {seasons} seasons of history make this a long story, and there is more to tell.
duets.co: Long stories are easy to start and much harder to finish with a flourish.

duets.lead: Expect fireworks before anybody has played a minute, with both bosses sending early warnings.
duets.co: Early warnings are cheap, but the pair are clearly enjoying handing them out.

duets.lead: {clubA} goes into the campaign with a bold plan, and {clubB} has the answers ready.
duets.co: Bold plans sound grand on paper, but they only matter once the real work begins.

duets.lead: Ahead of the opener, {managerA} smiles like someone who knows a secret.
duets.co: Smiles like that are harmless, and if there is a secret, {managerB} will sniff it out soon enough.

duets.lead: Big talk is in full flow, and {managerB} is determined not to be outdone.
duets.co: Talk is cheap, and only the points that follow will count in this Showdown.

duets.lead: We are about to find out whether {managerA}'s preparation is as clever as it sounds.
duets.co: Clever on paper is common; clever under pressure is what separates the good from the great.

duets.lead: Every rivalry needs a fresh start, and this chance gives {managerA} and {managerB} exactly that.
duets.co: Nobody turns down a clean slate, and both sides will be unwrapping it with a grin.

duets.lead: {trailer} has the chance to reset, and the clock is ticking.
duets.co: Resets are rare in a Showdown, and this one is a chance {trailer} would be foolish to waste.

duets.lead: What comes next could go either way, and both bosses know it.
duets.co: Nobody likes that answer, but it is the most honest thing anyone can say at this stage.

duets.lead: Here comes the next term, with {clubA} and {clubB} locked in for another round.
duets.co: Another round, another chance to settle old business, and neither side is backing away.

duets.lead: The table is blank at the start of the year, and everyone is hungry to fill it.
duets.co: An empty table is the great leveller, and it gives everyone a fair shot at glory.
